project_type: React + Vite SPA (frontend) in a TypeScript npm-workspaces monorepo (shared/backend/frontend/infra) for an MLB postseason summary site deployed via AWS CDK
build_system: npm workspaces. Root scripts run in dependency order shared -> backend -> frontend -> infra. node is on PATH but npm is NOT: prefix commands with PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" (v22.23.3 confirmed present).
test_framework: Vitest (unit + property + component via @testing-library/react/jsdom). Playwright for e2e in frontend/e2e/*.spec.ts (headless chromium, --no-sandbox).
verification_instructions: 1) npm run build (ordered shared->backend->frontend->infra) must pass. 2) npm test (vitest all workspaces) must pass. 3) npm run test:e2e -w frontend (Playwright; may need `npx playwright install chromium` once) must pass. 4) npm run synth (cdk synth, no AWS calls) must pass as a regression guard. Do NOT run cdk deploy. Do NOT make live Bedrock/MLB calls.
snapshot_or_generated_files: frontend build emits dist/ (gitignored). No committed snapshots. Playwright screenshots go to gitignored frontend/test-results/.
setup_instructions: node_modules already installed at repo root. If Playwright chromium missing: PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npx playwright install chromium (run from frontend/ or repo root).
environment_constraints: No live AWS/Bedrock/MLB calls. Frontend-only + docs change; no backend/infra source change expected. Reuse the pure shared predict()/backtest truncation for the probability overlay (never Bedrock). Branch feat/mlb-postseason-site; make incremental local commits (per steering). Do NOT push/PR/deploy (orchestrator owns that).
contribution_requirements: Steering .kiro/steering/*.md is inclusion:always: incremental commits; truthful specs/README (update .kiro/specs/mlb-postseason/{requirements,design,tasks}.md and BOTH README.md and README.ja.md); spec-driven development is graded. Testing steering: add unit tests next to code as *.test.ts, property tests as *.property.test.ts, e2e in frontend/e2e. Keep build/test/synth all green.
key_patterns: i18n: flat dotted-key dictionary in frontend/src/i18n/messages.ts (MessageKey union + MESSAGES[lang]); default JA; add every new string to the MessageKey union AND both ja/en tables; use useI18n()/t(). Team colors: frontend/src/teamColors.ts teamColor(teamId)->{primary,secondary}; frontend/src/readableTextColor.ts (relativeLuminance/contrastRatio/readableTextColor) for legible-on-color text. Theme: CSS custom properties on :root and [data-theme='dark'] in frontend/src/styles.css; reference vars (--surface,--border,--muted,--ink,--heading,--focus-ring etc.) so dark mode works; axes/labels/gridlines should use these vars not hardcoded colors. Pure helpers (e.g. gameTime.ts, upcomingGames.ts, ics.ts, bracketLayout.ts) are dependency-free and unit-tested with injected inputs. Series shape: Series.games[] each GameResult has away/home {teamId, score|null, isWinner|null} and seriesGameNumber; score diff per game = |away.score - home.score|, winner side via isWinner. Cumulative wins can be recomputed by counting isWinner among games. clinchWins(bestOf) in bracketLayout.ts. isPredictable(season) in @mlb/shared season.ts (CURRENT_YEAR=2026). The pure predict(series,bracket,winPct,accuracy) is in @mlb/shared; backtest.ts already implements per-game truncation (slice first k games, recompute high/low wins, call predict) in sampleSeries — reuse/extend this truncation approach for the win-prob trend rather than duplicating it.
relevant_files: frontend/src/pages/SeriesDetailPage.tsx (detail view where full charts go)
frontend/src/components/SeriesCard.tsx (bracket card where the sparkline goes)
frontend/src/components/BracketView.tsx (renders cards; keyboard roving model to not regress)
frontend/e2e/fixtures.ts (SAMPLE_2026_BRACKET, stubBracket2026, final ALCS 117-136 with games)
shared/src/predict.ts (pure predict - single source of truth for prob)
shared/src/backtest.ts (sampleSeries per-game truncation to reuse for prob trend)
shared/src/seed/postseason-2024.json and postseason-2025.json (completed seeds with full games)
directory_structure: shared/src: domain types, predict, backtest, season, seed JSON. backend/src: Lambda handlers (not touched). frontend/src: SPA. frontend/src/components: SeriesCard, BracketView, TeamBadge, panels. frontend/src/pages: HomePage, SeriesDetailPage, AccuracyPage. frontend/src/i18n: messages+index. frontend/e2e: Playwright specs + fixtures. infra/src: CDK (not touched).
